source_posture: Primary issuer releases independently read; historical SEC observation gates remain authoritative.
assumption_label: Analyst assumptions, not issuer forecasts or consensus estimates
assumption_label_he: הנחות ניתוח להמחשה; אינן תחזיות הנהלה או קונצנזוס
valuation_date_basis: Analyst planning date near FY2030 end; not a confirmed future issuer reporting or share-sale date.

base.shares_note: This is an annual EPS denominator, not current or period-end shares outstanding. Future share changes are assumptions about each annual diluted denominator.
base.fcf_definition: Operating cash flow minus gross cash purchases of property, plant and equipment; excludes intangibles, asset-sale proceeds, incentives, noncash capex and finance-lease principal.

revenue.locator: Annual income statement, FY2026 revenue column, USD millions

net_income.locator: Annual income statement, FY2026 GAAP net income column, USD millions

reported_eps.locator: Annual income statement, FY2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share

shares_diluted.locator: Annual income statement, FY2026 weighted-average diluted shares, millions

free_cash_flow.locator: Annual cash-flow statement, FY2026 operating cash flow less gross cash PP&E additions, USD millions
free_cash_flow.formula: 89675m operating cash flow - 30712m gross cash PP&E = 58963m

context.label: Issuer guidance
context.text: FY2027 Q1 revenue guidance is $61.5bn ± $1.5bn. The full FY2027–2030 paths are independent analyst assumptions, including a cyclical decline.

scenarios.label: Bear
scenarios.rationale: After near-term expansion, memory supply catches demand: falling DRAM/NAND prices and underutilization cause a deep earnings cycle. Fab commitments consume cash even as profit contracts; dilution and a low exit multiple add downside.
scenarios.rationale_he: לאחר צמיחה בטווח הקרוב, היצע הזיכרון משיג את הביקוש. ירידת מחירי DRAM ו-NAND וניצולת נמוכה גורמות לירידה חדה ברווח. התחייבויות למפעלים צורכות מזומן, והדילול והמכפיל הנמוך מחמירים את התוצאה.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A lower earnings multiple reflects weaker durability and higher risk.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.rationale: FY2027 expansion is followed by a deliberate memory-cycle downturn in FY2029 and partial recovery. HBM mix and customer agreements help, but new capacity erodes unusually high margins. Gross cash capex remains a material cash burden.
scenarios.rationale_he: הצמיחה ב-FY2027 מתחלפת במחזור ירידה ב-FY2029 ובהתאוששות חלקית. תמהיל HBM והסכמים עם לקוחות מסייעים, אך קיבולת חדשה שוחקת רווחיות חריגה. ההשקעה הגולמית במפעלים ממשיכה לצרוך מזומן.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A selected mid-case earnings multiple, not a market consensus or peer-derived target.

scenarios.label: Bull
scenarios.rationale: AI memory demand and supply discipline delay a sharp downcycle. HBM execution and long-duration agreements sustain strong margins, while capacity additions still lower margins by FY2030. No net dilution and a higher multiple are additional assumptions.
scenarios.rationale_he: ביקוש לזיכרון AI ומשמעת היצע דוחים ירידה חדה במחזור. ביצועי HBM והסכמים ממושכים תומכים ברווחיות, אך תוספת הקיבולת עדיין מורידה מרווחים עד FY2030. גם היעדר דילול ומכפיל גבוה הם הנחות.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A premium earnings multiple requires durable growth and cash conversion.

sources.title: Micron fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 earnings release

reasons: Historical and quote gates are evaluated at build time.

limitations: Scenario paths, margins, share changes and exit P/E are analyst assumptions without probability weights; the range is not a confidence interval.
Future earnings are calculated as revenue times an assumed GAAP-style net margin; no detailed tax, investment-gain or stock-compensation bridge is forecast.
Future FCF is revenue times an assumed strict cash-PP&E FCF margin, not a fully balanced cash-flow forecast or discounted cash-flow valuation.
Price-only annualized return uses the actual interval from the displayed quote date to the assumed exit date. It excludes dividends, taxes, fees and currency effects.
No enterprise-value/debt bridge is used. Weighted-average diluted shares cannot be used as current shares outstanding for market capitalization.
Numerical validation does not establish forecast reliability. Inputs require review after each material release or corporate action.
